app.name: Audit Report Anchoring
app.tagline: Anchor audit-report PDFs on a public testnet, and let anyone check a copy in their browser.
app.prototypeNotice: Prototype. Testnet anchors are not legal evidence.

kitchenSink.title: UI kit
kitchenSink.intro: Every component this repo copies from Inflect, rendered in this app's theme.
kitchenSink.clientHint: The UIC for a Bulgarian company.
kitchenSink.opinionDescription: Confirm the text exactly as it appears in the report.
kitchenSink.tooltipContent: A 32-byte SHA-256 value. Only commitments go on chain.
kitchenSink.emptyDescription: Upload an audit report to anchor its first version.
kitchenSink.errorDescription: The two RPC endpoints disagree, so no verdict is shown.
kitchenSink.modalBody: A second person approves every anchor before it is broadcast.
kitchenSink.confirmBody: Revocation is permanent and visible to every verifier.
kitchenSink.sheetBody: Each version names its parent, so every copy resolves to the latest.

nav.lowBalance: The issuer key's balance is below 0.02 ETH. Anchors will fail once it runs out: top it up.

login.title: Sign in
login.failed: The email or password is wrong, or there have been too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.

empty.title: No engagements yet
empty.description: A preparer creates an engagement, then uploads the first version of its report.

engagement.newIntro: An engagement is one report and all its versions. Its details form the report's pseudonymous id; only that id, never these details, ever goes on chain.
engagement.registrationNumberHint: The UIC for a Bulgarian company. Spaces are ignored.
engagement.engagementRefHint: Your firm's own reference for this engagement.

upload.title: Upload a version
upload.fileHint: At most 25 MB and 500 pages. The file is stored encrypted.
upload.reason: Why is the report being reissued?
upload.draftPending: A draft version is waiting for its opinion to be confirmed. Confirm or discard it before uploading another.

errors.CROSS_ORIGIN: This request did not come from this site.

errors.UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE: Only PDF files can be uploaded.
errors.DOC_ALREADY_UPLOADED: This exact file has already been uploaded.

errors.FOUR_EYES: You prepared or confirmed this version, so someone else must approve it.

errors.CHAIN_NOT_CONFIGURED: Anchoring is not configured on this server.
errors.PREDECESSOR_NOT_ANCHORED: The previous version must be anchored before this one can be approved.

errors.MODE_SKIPS_RUNG: The write mode widens one step at a time: Disabled, then Dry run, then Live.

refusals.ENCRYPTED: This PDF needs a password to open. Upload a copy that opens without one.

viewer.failed: The PDF could not be shown.

notFound.NO_TEXT_LAYER: This PDF has no text layer (it may be a scan), so the opinion could not be read from it.
notFound.MULTIPLE_OPINION_HEADINGS: More than one opinion heading was found, for example in a bilingual report.
notFound.NO_BASIS_HEADING: The opinion heading was found, but not the "Basis for…" heading after it.
notFound.HEADING_TYPE_MISMATCH: The opinion heading and the "Basis for…" heading name different opinion types.
notFound.OPINION_TOO_LONG: The text found is too long to be only the opinion.

confirm.foundHint: Found under the heading "{heading}" on pages {from}–{to}. Check it against the report.
confirm.typeItIn: Type or paste the opinion paragraph from the report.
confirm.textDescription: Exactly as it appears in the report. Spacing and line breaks do not matter.
confirm.reportDateHint: The date the report was signed.
confirm.dialogBody: The type and text become part of this version's commitment, which will be anchored. They cannot be changed afterwards; a correction is a new version.
confirm.discardBody: The uploaded file and everything extracted from it are deleted. Nothing has been anchored.

version.anchorOnlySigned: This PDF carries a digital signature, so it will be anchored as it is and never rewritten.
version.anchorOnlyProtected: This PDF is protected against editing, so it will be anchored as it is and never rewritten.

flags.xfa: This PDF contains an XFA form.

version.awaitingPreparer: Waiting for a preparer to confirm the opinion.
version.commitmentsHint: Only these values will go on chain. Nothing has been anchored yet.

anchoring.title: Anchoring
anchoring.prototypeEvidence: Anchors are recorded on a public test network. They are prototype evidence, not a legally binding record.
anchoring.anchored: Anchored: the record's block {block} is finalized.
anchoring.notConfigured: Anchoring is not configured on this server.
anchoring.disabled: Chain writes are disabled for your firm.
anchoring.settingsLink: Change the write mode in Settings.
anchoring.dryRunHint: Dry run: approving simulates the anchor against the registry and records the result. Nothing is sent.
anchoring.liveHint: Approving queues the anchor. The worker sends it from the issuer key and marks it final once its block is finalized.
anchoring.approveBody: You confirm that you have checked the confirmed opinion against the report. The version's commitments will be sent to the registry; once a block holds them they cannot be withdrawn, only revoked.
anchoring.approveBodyDryRun: You confirm that you have checked the confirmed opinion against the report. In dry run the anchor is only simulated and recorded; nothing is sent.
anchoring.waitingApprover: Waiting for an approver. Someone other than the preparer approves the anchor.
anchoring.queued: Approved by {approver}. The anchor is queued for the worker.
anchoring.noWrites: Nothing has been sent or simulated for this version.
anchoring.wouldSucceed: The simulation succeeded: a live anchor would be accepted.
anchoring.replaced: Replaced {count, plural, one {once} other {# times}} at the same nonce with a higher fee.

status.INDETERMINATE: Outcome unknown, being read from the chain

reasons.StaleParent: Another version became the family's latest after this one was prepared. Start again from the new latest.
reasons.FAMILY_LATEST_MISMATCH: The family's latest record on chain is not the version before this one, so the parent cannot be determined.
reasons.PREDECESSOR_NOT_ANCHORED: The previous version is not anchored.
reasons.DOC_ANCHORED_ELSEWHERE: This exact file is already anchored, as a different record.
reasons.DocAlreadyAnchored: This exact file is already anchored.
reasons.MODE_NARROWED: The write mode was narrowed before this anchor was sent, so it was not sent.
reasons.VERSION_NOT_APPROVED: The version was no longer approved.
reasons.NONCE_CONSUMED: Another transaction used this write's slot, so it can never be mined. Approve again to retry.
reasons.TX_REVERTED: The transaction was mined but the registry refused it.
reasons.SEND_REJECTED: The node refused the transaction before sending it; nothing was broadcast.
reasons.REPLACEMENT_REJECTED: A higher-fee replacement was refused; the original transaction is still pending.
reasons.ISSUER_BLOCKED: Waiting: an earlier write with an unknown outcome must be settled first.
reasons.SEND_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN: The worker stopped while sending. The outcome is being read from the chain; nothing is resent.
reasons.TX_NOT_FOUND: The node no longer knows the transaction. The outcome is being read from the chain; nothing is resent.
reasons.NO_RPC_ANSWER: The node did not answer the send. The outcome is being read from the chain; nothing is resent.
reasons.NONCE_TOO_LOW: The node says this slot is already used. The outcome is being read from the chain.
reasons.RPC_ERROR: The node answered with an unexpected error. The outcome is being read from the chain; nothing is resent.
reasons.RECORD_MISMATCH: The record on chain does not match what was sent. A person must look at this.
reasons.CANNOT_REPLACE: The pending transaction could not be replaced.
reasons.NotIssuer: The issuer key is not registered with the registry.
reasons.STAMP_CHECK: The stamped copy did not pass its check against the original and the final record, so nothing was stored or sent.
reasons.ANCHOR_ONLY: This version is signed or edit-protected, so it is never stamped.
reasons.COPY_NEEDS_LIVE: A distribution copy is anchored only in Live mode.
reasons.CopyExists: The original already has a distribution copy on chain, made from another file.
reasons.RecordRevoked: The original record has been revoked.
reasons.KIND_UNSUPPORTED: The worker does not send this kind of write.

anchoring.completeCopy: Complete: the stamped distribution copy is anchored too. Hand recipients this copy; its metadata names its own record.
anchoring.completeCertificate: Complete. This report is signed or protected against editing, so it was anchored as issued. Hand recipients the report as issued together with its verification certificate.
anchoring.copyPending: The original is anchored. Its distribution copy is being stamped, checked and anchored.
anchoring.copyFailed: The original is anchored, but its distribution copy was not. See the reason below.
anchoring.certificatePending: Anchored as issued. The verification certificate is being prepared.
anchoring.retryBody: The worker stamps the original again (or reuses a copy already checked) and anchors it from the issuer key. The version's approval covers its copy.

settings.title: Settings
settings.modeIntro: How far approved anchors go. Widening moves one step at a time; narrowing takes effect at once and stops anything not yet sent.

modeDescriptions.DISABLED: nothing can be approved for anchoring
modeDescriptions.DRY_RUN: an approval simulates the anchor and records the outcome; nothing is sent
modeDescriptions.LIVE: an approval sends the anchor from the issuer key

changeBody.DISABLED: Approvals stop. Anchors not yet sent will not be sent.
changeBody.DRY_RUN: Approvals will only simulate anchors. Live anchors not yet sent will not be sent.
changeBody.LIVE: Approvals will send transactions from the issuer key, paid from its balance. A sent anchor cannot be withdrawn.

settings.approverOnly: Only an approver can change the write mode.
settings.balanceUnknown: The worker has not checked the issuer balance yet.
settings.notConfigured: Anchoring is not configured on this server: set ANCHOR_NETWORK and ISSUER_ADDRESS, and deploy the registry.

verify.title: Verify an audit report
verify.intro: Choose or drop a PDF. It is checked here, in your browser, and never uploaded: the page computes the file's fingerprint and reads the public registry directly.
verify.checksAgainst: Checked against the registry {contract} on {network}, read through two endpoints whose answers must agree.
verify.disclaimer: Records on a public test network are prototype evidence, not a legally binding record.
verify.notConfigured: The verifier is not configured on this server.

setupRefusal.NOT_CONFIGURED: No network is set (VERIFY_NETWORK or ANCHOR_NETWORK).
setupRefusal.NETWORK_INVALID: VERIFY_NETWORK must be sepolia or local.
setupRefusal.DEPLOYMENT_UNAVAILABLE: The registry's deployment record is missing or does not match this build.
setupRefusal.RPC_URLS_MISSING: VERIFY_RPC_URL_1 and VERIFY_RPC_URL_2 must both be set.
setupRefusal.RPC_URLS_INVALID: The verifier's RPC endpoints must be https URLs without credentials.
setupRefusal.RPC_URLS_NOT_INDEPENDENT: The verifier's two RPC endpoints must be on different hosts.

AUTHENTIC_LATEST.title: Authentic, latest version
AUTHENTIC_LATEST.body: This file is byte for byte the file the issuer anchored, and no newer version has been issued.

AUTHENTIC_SUPERSEDED.title: Authentic, superseded
AUTHENTIC_SUPERSEDED.body: This file is byte for byte the file the issuer anchored, but the issuer has since anchored version {latest} of this report. Rely on the latest version.

REVOKED.title: Revoked
REVOKED.body: This file was anchored by the issuer and later revoked. Do not rely on it.

ALTERED_OPINION_CHANGED.title: Altered: the opinion differs
ALTERED_OPINION_CHANGED.body: This is not the file the issuer anchored. It refers to an anchored report, but the audit opinion in it does not match that report's opinion. This is strong evidence that the opinion was edited.

ALTERED_OPINION_APPEARS_UNCHANGED.title: Not the registered file; the opinion text matches
ALTERED_OPINION_APPEARS_UNCHANGED.body: This is not the file the issuer anchored. It refers to an anchored report, and the opinion text in it matches that report's opinion. That shows only that the opinion wording is the same: anything else in the file may have changed. Ask the issuer for the registered file.

ALTERED_OPINION_NOT_CHECKABLE.title: Not the registered file; the opinion could not be checked
ALTERED_OPINION_NOT_CHECKABLE.body: This is not the file the issuer anchored. It refers to an anchored report, but the opinion could not be found in its text, so it could not be compared.

UNKNOWN_REGISTRY.title: Refers to another registry
UNKNOWN_REGISTRY.body: This file refers to a record on chain {chainId} at {contract}, which this verifier does not check. Nothing has been verified.

CANNOT_VERIFY.title: Cannot verify right now
CANNOT_VERIFY.body: No verdict was reached. {reason} Try again later.

notRegistered.NO_REFERENCE: No report anchored in this registry is this exact file, and the file carries no anchor reference. This says nothing either way about where the file came from.
notRegistered.REFERENCE_UNREADABLE: No report anchored in this registry is this exact file. The file carries an anchor reference, but it is not well formed.
notRegistered.NAMES_UNKNOWN_RECORD: No report anchored in this registry is this exact file. The file refers to a record that this registry does not hold.
notRegistered.PDF_UNREADABLE: No report anchored in this registry is this exact file, and the file could not be read as a PDF to look for an anchor reference.

cannotVerify.RPC_UNREACHABLE: A blockchain endpoint could not be reached.
cannotVerify.WRONG_CHAIN: A blockchain endpoint is on a different network than this verifier expects.
cannotVerify.WRONG_CONTRACT: The contract at the registry address is not the expected registry.
cannotVerify.RPC_DISAGREE: The two blockchain endpoints gave different answers.
cannotVerify.CHAIN_INCONSISTENT: The registry returned records that do not fit together.
cannotVerify.FILE_TOO_LARGE: The file is larger than 25 MB.

latest.title: Latest version of a report
latest.invalidId: This is not a report id.
latest.notFound: No anchored report has this id.
latest.noPdf: This page shows the record only. Get the file from the issuer, then check it on the verify page.
